task: Fixed-tip pivot calibration test: initial tracking acquisition, then closed jaw-tip midpoint held at one stationary point while rotating about multiple axes.

board_calibration.note: Selected for continuation; independent segment differed by 74.6 mm and 3.9 degrees. Timing and spatial accuracy not verified. In this candidate, spatial transforms are replaced by nominal CAD; time offset remains inherited.

tool_geometry.tcp_definition: TCP is midpoint of CAD distal tip ends. Export labels their placement illustrative; actual pressure contact centroid and motion with jaw opening are not registered.
assumptions: Video establishes forward orientation but does not measure hidden contact-plane clearance; +4 mm assembly translation assumes flush holder/base mating.
Forward adapter/D405 seating is a video-informed interpretation. Supplied assembly README instead specifies adapter behind holder; that alternative is calculated explicitly.
T265 5.95 mm back-to-IMU-reference depth is used as a nominal pose PCB depth, not a verified pose-origin depth. Factory extrinsics query found no T265 device.

pivot_test.instructions: Close jaws, keep the same jaw-tip midpoint on a fixed physical point; slowly tilt in two independent directions without sliding or changing opening. Inspect actual tracking confidence before analysis.
